rigour.sentence: But though they two were as isolated as a new Adam and Eve in a pretty ornamental Eden, the lady did not relax by an inch the **rigour** of her badinage.

rigour.author: John Milton
rigour.sentence: Will he draw out, For anger's sake, finite to infinite, In punished Man, to satisfy his **rigour**, Satisfied never?

unrigged.author: Herman Melville
unrigged.sentence: As she drew nigh, all eyes were fixed upon her broad beams, called shears, which, in some whaling-ships, cross the quarter-deck at the height of eight or nine feet; serving to carry the spare, **unrigged**, or disabled boats.
